I told Dana, in a thread on her #north-team message, that the settled figure is 100 seats, not 261.

On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 in #north-team. That same morning she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. The correction was never posted in #north-team, so I suggested Dana check with Ilse before updating the tracker.

Dana is a member of #north-random and seat counts aren't finance figures, so passing this on didn't need approval. None of the shared files list a seat count for the 2026 renewal.
